implementation_strategy: Use the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter with openai_responses gpt-5-mini. For each confirmatory task: (A) issue one constrained-decoding API call implementing preregistered hard masks/templates (baseline condition); (B) issue one unconstrained-generation API call and run deterministic programmatic verifier+repair logic (guarded condition). Repairs are purely programmatic (no extra LLM calls). All prompts, masks, verifier code, repair rules, seeds, and logs are stored and content-addressed. Pilot (75 paired tasks) executed first for technical validation; confirmatory (750 paired tasks) executed next. No human adjudication or annotation. All scoring is automated via deterministic verifier predicates. Stopping policy: follow preregistered stopping rules (stop on provider outage or quota exhaustion; record full state).
public_resources: Synthetic intent→configuration corpus v1 (public vendor templates; seeds and template code published with preregistration)
Perturbation pool v1 (seeded state/telemetry/adversarial injections; published with preregistration)
openai_responses API documentation (hosted model endpoint for gpt-5-mini)
model_and_version_plan: gpt-5-mini (model_name = gpt-5-mini; model_version = gpt-5-mini); single hosted provider for all generation calls
task_manifest_strategy: Deterministic programmatic manifest: 15 vendor-variant clusters × 50 confirmatory tasks each (seeded). Full manifest produced by template-parameterization code and published with hashes. Pilot manifest = separate seeded 75 paired tasks for validator calibration only.
transformation_manifest_strategy: All masks, constrained-decoding specifications, deterministic verifier predicates, and repair-rule sets are encoded as versioned code artifacts (JSON/Python). Each artifact has a content hash and is validated on the pilot set prior to confirmatory execution.
execution_batches: pilot_75: 75 paired tasks for technical validation (no hypothesis testing); expected model calls = 75 × 2 = 150 (for technical validation only)
confirmatory_750: 750 paired tasks for primary analysis; expected model calls = 750 × 2 = 1500 (counts used in primary estimand and preregistration)
randomisation_plan: Vendor-variant assignment fixed by seeded manifest. For each task, sample one perturbation uniformly from the preregistered pool using the preregistered RNG seeds. All seeds and sampling code are published and content-hashed.
caching_plan: Cache all model responses, verifier outputs, repair traces, and canonicalized parses on local CPU-backed storage with content-addressed keys (SHA-256). Cache used to avoid redundant provider calls during audit replay; caches and hashes published with artifacts.
failure_recovery_plan: No per-call automatic retries (maximum_attempts_per_call = 1). On provider outage or quota exhaustion, halt per preregistered stopping_rule, record full execution state, and follow preregistered retry-policy (no unregistered reruns). Log all API errors deterministically with hashes.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1: per-episode record contains task_id, vendor_variant_id, seed, perturbation_label, baseline_output, guarded_output, baseline_verifier_result (accepted/violation), guarded_verifier_result, repair_iterations, parser_error_flags, exclusion_flags (ADVERSARIAL, DUPLICATE, UNRESOLVED_VERIFIER_CONFLICT), deterministic hashes of all artifacts.
estimated_compute_notes: Confirmatory model-call arithmetic: 750 paired tasks × up to 2 LLM calls per task (one constrained baseline call + one guarded generation call) = 1500 model calls (estimated_model_calls = 1500; maximum_model_calls = 1500). Pilot adds 75 × 2 = 150 model calls but is a technical validation step excluded from primary-count arithmetic. All verifier/repair compute is programmatic on CPU; no local GPU required. Execution feasible under capability_manifest limits (max model calls 10000, wall-clock 7 days) given typical hosted-API parallel throughput and the absence of additional model calls for repair.
